name: project-planning
description: Start large, ambiguous projects: outline the system with the user, turn it into a risk-first roadmap of end-to-end increments, then design each increment just before building it

interface.shortDescription: Design a project, then plan it risk-first
interface.longDescription: Draft a one-page system outline with flagged assumptions, component depth tags, and a risk register (or adopt an existing codebase as-is), order the work as end-to-end increments that each answer the riskiest remaining unknown, then design each increment just before it is built and fold what was built back into the design. Tuned for Apple-platform apps.
defaultPrompt: Use $system-design to shape a high-level design for this project idea.
Use $risk-first-roadmap to turn the system design into an incremental roadmap.
Use $roadmap-plan-next-rung to plan the next rung of the roadmap before building it.
